candidate_windows.window_text: We use the pre-trained RoBERTa (Liu et al., 2019) model with 768-dimension base version provided by the HuggingFace transformers $^2$ (Wolf et al., 2020). Our implementation is based on PyTorch framework $^3$ , running on NVIDIA GTX 3090 GPUs. The training process costs approximately 5 GPU hours on average. We set the learning rate to 1e-5, batch size to 16. The contrastive loss ratio $\beta$ is set to 0.5, the temperature parameter $\tau$ is set to 1.0, and the number of demonstrations is set to 4, viz. $(M,N) = (2,2)$ . All trainable parameters are randomly initialized from normal distributions.
